title: LinkedIn Job Search (burner account only)
description: Searches LinkedIn job listings and returns title, company, location, posted date and link. REQUIRES a LinkedIn session cookie from a SEPARATE THROWAWAY ACCOUNT — never your real one. LinkedIn restricts accounts it detects scraping, and a restriction on your main account during a job search is expensive. Requests are hard-capped at 80 per UTC day across all runs, with randomized delays.

keywords.description: Job search keywords, e.g. "performance marketing manager".

remoteOnly.description: Restrict to roles LinkedIn labels remote.

postedWithinDays.description: Only roles posted within this many days.

maxResults.description: Maximum listings to return. Also bounded by the 80-per-day cap shared across all runs.
